title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Determined to clear Abinaya's name, Vetri vows expose Karna. Meanwhile, Karna turns ruthless, assaults Manickam when he urges his help to escape his troubled past.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar and Poongodi unexpectedly win the rangoli competition despite last-minute mishaps. Later, they participate in a slow cycle race, where Azhagar deliberately decides to lose.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj exposes Malar and Revathi's fake dietitian scheme to the family. Malar defends her actions as health-focused, but Thangaraj issues a stern warning.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian insults Senthil in front of his family for his high electricity usage and being jobless. Later, Meena consoles him and promises to leave the house with him soon.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha cooks dinner for the family and prepares for her wedding night with Cheran. As Chozhan teases a shy Cheran, Nila steps in to stop the teasing.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini begins pregnancy vlogging with healthy tips. Later, Nachiyar makes Vijaya grind rice using a stone grinder which causes burden to her with backpain.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam's family celebrates Vinayagar Chathurthi grandly as Sethupathi stuns everyone with his dance for the deity.  Aishwarya refuses to help Eshwari with her criminal plot.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya rejoices over Madhu's positive change towards Arjun. Meanwhile, Kasthuri is shocked when Karthik asks her to remove her Thali to keep their marriage secret at college.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira and Murugan spot Shanmugam at a cafe with Abhi and mock him at home. Later, Shanmugam discloses his relationship and asks his family to keep it secret from his parents.
